name: Optimization-Conflict Trap
description: The problem statement explicitly warns that the test cases are adversarial and will cause TLE for naive fixed-order sequential assignment. It suggests using dynamic variable selection heuristics (like MRV) to speed up the search. Models that blindly apply this optimization will break the fixed-order evaluation required to naturally find the lexicographically smallest solution. To succeed, a model must genuinely reason about the conflict between dynamic variable ordering and the lexicographical constraint, and resolve it correctly (e.g., by using forward checking while strictly maintaining the fixed variable order, or by iteratively checking satisfiability for fixed prefixes).
